children: shares rose 3.30% intraday after chairman and CEO Ryan Cohen disclosed buying 1,150,680 Class A shares at a weighted-average $22.9375, worth roughly $26.4 million, in open-market transactions. The purchase lifts his direct holding to 44,233,306 shares including warrants, or 8.7% of the class. At current prices, that stake is worth just over $1 billion.
Cohen has steadily added to his position since taking control of the company. Earlier, on September 10, he acquired 1,000,000 Class A shares at a weighted-average $20.3759.

title: Cohen Adds to GameStop Stake for a Second Time This Month
